# dimdams_scheduled_tasks (Resource)

Toutes les tâches planifiées d'un service (10 au plus), chaque jour à l'heure de Paris. Une commande demande la permission hosts:exec. Import : `<host_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dimdams_scheduled_tasks" "night" {
  host_id = data.dimdams_service.vps.id

  task {
    name   = "Sauvegarde"
    action = "backup"
    time   = "03:00"
  }

  task {
    name   = "Redémarrage"
    action = "restart"
    time   = "04:00"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String) Identifiant du service (par exemple vps-1793740523964-d3bw0r).

### Optional

- `task` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--task))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--task"></a>
### Nested Schema for `task`

Required:

- `action` (String) restart, backup ou command.
- `name` (String) Nom, unique parmi les tâches du service.
- `time` (String) Heure de Paris, HH:MM.

Optional:

- `command` (String) Commande pour action = command (une ligne, 512 caractères au plus).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Tâche active (true par défaut).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import dimdams_scheduled_tasks.night <host_id>
```
